info.name: Lisa AI - HTTP Endpoints
info.description: Postman collection for the raw HTTP routes exposed by Lisa AI's Convex backend (convex/http.ts). Most of the app talks to Convex via the client SDK (queries/mutations/actions), which Postman can't call directly - these are the two routes that ARE plain HTTP and can be exercised here: /chat-stream and /tts-stream. Both require a Clerk JWT.

variable.description: Your Convex deployment's HTTP Actions URL (found via `npx convex dashboard` or in .env.local as VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL)
A valid Clerk session JWT for a signed-in test user. Grab it from the browser dev tools while signed into the app, or by temporarily logging the result of Clerk's getToken() client-side.
An existing Convex conversation _id, created via the app or the conversations.create mutation.

request.description: Streams a Gemini chat reply as plain UTF-8 text chunks (no SSE framing - just concatenate the response body). Saves the user message and the assistant's reply to the conversation. Requires a valid Clerk bearer token and an existing conversationId owned by that user. Returns 401 if unauthenticated, 400 if conversationId/message is missing, 403 if the conversation isn't owned by the caller.
Answers the browser's CORS preflight for /chat-stream. Not needed when calling directly from Postman (no CORS in play), included for completeness.

Streams back raw MP3 audio bytes (audio/mpeg) generated by ElevenLabs. Requires a valid Clerk bearer token. Returns 204 with no body if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY isn't configured on the deployment or the text is empty (client falls back to browser TTS in that case), 401 if unauthenticated, 400 on invalid JSON. In Postman, use 'Send and Download' to save the response as an .mp3 file.
Answers the browser's CORS preflight for /tts-stream. Not needed when calling directly from Postman, included for completeness.

item.name: Clerk Webhook (reference only - not directly testable)

request.description: Kept here for documentation purposes only. This route verifies a svix signature generated by Clerk itself (using CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET) - a hand-built Postman request will fail signature verification (400 Invalid signature) unless you replicate svix's signing scheme. To actually exercise this route, trigger a real user create/update/delete in Clerk's dashboard or in the app and watch the Convex function logs.
